Components

Source: vignettes/articles/components.Rmd
components.Rmd

Every component Element UI documents, in the order and groups of Element’s own documentation. Each page has Element’s demos in R – live where they need no server, a screenshot of the running app where they do – and Element’s API tables, with where each entry is in R.
